shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '*.css' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' /home/sandbox 2>/dev/null | head -70"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version dist.unpackedSize && rg 'useTheme|useThemeType' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks -n | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/index.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/mixins/batch-updates.js && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/mixins/transform-series.js && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/defaults.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/legend/legend.d.ts && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/cpu-browser-libs && cd /tmp/cpu-browser-libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpixman-1-0 libpng16-16 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libxrender1 libthai0 libharfbuzz0b libfribidi0 libdatrie1 libgraphite2-3 libpcre2-8-0 libmount1 libselinux1 libffi8 libblkid1'

/bin/bash -lc 'for package in /tmp/cpu-browser-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/cpu-browser-libs/root; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/cpu-browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg '"'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/cpu-browser-libs && apt-get download libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3 libwayland-server0 libxi6
for package in /tmp/cpu-browser-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/cpu-browser-libs/root; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/cpu-browser-libs && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core
for package in /tmp/cpu-browser-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/cpu-browser-libs/root; done'

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/cpu-browser-libs/fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>
<"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd">
<fontconfig><dir>/tmp/cpu-browser-libs/root/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu</dir><cachedir>/tmp/cpu-browser-libs/font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/cpu-browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/cpu-browser-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/cpu-browser-libs/fonts.conf npm run test:e2e'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=prettier@3.6.2 -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/CpuChart.tsx src/cpuMetrics.ts src/main.tsx src/styles.css tests/CpuChart.test.tsx tests/cpuMetrics.test.ts tests/monitoring.spec.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts README.md'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- package.json src/main.tsx && rg -n 'getHistory|snapshot|dispose|setTheme|ResizeObserver' src/CpuChart.tsx src/cpuMetrics.ts && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'function setSize|function _setSize|function redraw|_size' node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.esm.js | tail -25 && sed -n '3460,3505p' node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.esm.js"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=prettier@3.6.2 -- prettier --write src/CpuChart.tsx src/styles.css tests/CpuChart.test.tsx tests/monitoring.spec.ts && npm test && npm run build && git diff --check'
